notes.title: Update Notes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone
We are working on the maps now and updating the current version according to players' suggestion as well. 
Hope we could release 1-2 new maps in next update, for this time we have:
[list]
[*][b]Added tower type descriptions.[/b]
[*][b]Adjusted difficulty ramp for first 5 maps.[/b]
[*][b]Allow player put down the boulder if have picked it up but don't want to throw it for some reason, without losing one boulder.[/b]
[*][b]Fixed some tiny bugs.[/b]
[/list]
Thanks a lot for your support and suggestions.

notes.title: Update Notes
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*]Replace Pad button by Grip button for teleport to avoid any unexpected teleport while building towers.
[*]Add a master settings button which is the parent of all sub-settings buttons to avoid touching "Quit" or "Restart" button accidentally.
[*]Fix tiny bugs.
[*]Add some tips for new starter.
[/olist]

notes.title: Release Issuse Solved
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone
Steam experiencing some server issues when we released, they've fixed already.
You can download the game now.
Hope you will like it and feel free to give us your feedback.
Thanks a lot for all your support.
